headline: Paraguay President Impeached and Arrested Following Bank Collapse
summary: Paraguayan President Santiago Peña was impeached, removed from office, and placed under house arrest following the collapse of a bank tied to his administration.
why: Santiago Peña served as President of Paraguay, a key South American agricultural exporter. Political instability and banking collapses can negatively affect national sovereign debt and regional financial market stability.

impacts.name: Paraguay
impacts.why: Political crisis and executive turnover following a banking collapse directly affect Paraguay's economic stability.
